scope: Retained product claims and decisions about removed claims; not a complete revalidation of every historical statistic.
method: Primary HubSpot pages read online during this editorial round. Presence of a vendor statistic does not prove a universal outcome or causal provider comparison. Editorial recommendations are not product guarantees. No numeric confidence score invented.

retained_primary_claims.topic: Breeze Assistant name, functions, settings and permissions
retained_primary_claims.decision: Current Assistant terminology and task/access explanation retained.

retained_primary_claims.topic: Customer Agent source types and private-source visibility
retained_primary_claims.decision: KB, site pages, URLs and files retained; private source content may appear in responses even without citing that source.

retained_primary_claims.topic: Content Agent beta requirements and context
retained_primary_claims.decision: Current documented beta requires Marketing Hub Professional or Enterprise; do not assume all features are included with Content Hub.
Review before sending versus send without review documented. Narrow/manual pilot is editorial advice.
Standard data enrichment does not consume HubSpot Credits; smart properties do. Subscription requirements still apply.
Business email/domain and differing automatic/manual/continuous update behavior retained.
Usage, subscriptions/seats, allowances and overage settings retained; no old dollar pricing repeated.
Sourced/assisted/managed recurring-revenue points plus program requirements; not completed implementation counts.

editorial_recommendations: Small pilots, review-enabled outreach and provider-selection questions are recommendations. No client tests, cost savings or product outcomes measured.
limits: Documentation may change after the review date. No live HubSpot agent/enrichment execution, billing or provider purchase tested.
